import math
from collections import defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = defaultdict(list)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value not in (0, 5):
                points[value].append((r, c))
    out = [[0 for _ in range(m // 3)] for _ in range(n // 3)]
    for value, coords in points.items():
        r = sum(p[0] for p in coords) // len(coords) // 3
        c = sum(p[1] for p in coords) // len(coords) // 3
        out[r][c] = value
    return out

def transform(grid):
